frame: Who: a seller with a sale to send. Carol ships one thing now and then and wants it done right; a flipper prints every label due in one go.
Came to: get the label, know where to drop it off and by when, and see when the money lands.

A mistake costs most where a deadline passes (the site cancels and marks the seller), a label is bought for a sale already cancelled, or a parcel goes without tracking and the buyer says it never came.
Ways out (spec/ways-out.md §6.9): ship it myself, with tracking or without and what going without costs; Cancel sale from here, with what it costs on that site; Undo after a label prints.
In the loop: buying a label spends money, so it waits for its own tap with the amount on it; instant payout costs money, so it is offered with its fee and never chosen for them.

decisions.decision: The ship-by day is on the item's tag; a countdown shows only inside the last day
decisions.why: Calm and visible: a countdown changes what the person does only when hours are left (frontend-standard §5, Honesty).

decisions.decision: The label's service and box are guesses, each one tap to change
decisions.why: The agent fills what it measured; the person corrects it (spec/features/assist.md, dotted guesses).

decisions.decision: This one or All N, as two chips, when more than one sale waits
decisions.why: The batch print in sold.md; a flipper prints every label with one approval, Carol prints one.

decisions.decision: In a batch, each row shows its own progress, and a failed row gets its own Retry while the rest carry on
Drop-off spots with the next time each takes a parcel, the door included
decisions.why: It is Sunday in the demo; USPS carrier pickup is free for Ground Advantage (sold.md).

decisions.decision: Your money: Sold, On its way, Ready on the site, In your bank, each with its date or the site's rule
decisions.why: Ben's edge cases, 05:05 (spec/edge-cases.md §2): the money moves through four words.

decisions.decision: Instant payout is a second chip with its fee, only where the site states the fee
decisions.why: edge-cases §2: shown with its fee, never the default. Mercari $3 is observed, Poshmark $2 asserted; eBay, Depop and Facebook not found.

decisions.decision: A thing sold on two sites offers no label until a buyer is picked on Today
decisions.why: edge-cases §1: the double sale card lives on Today, and the cancelled sale never gets a label.

decisions.decision: Cancel sale confirms in a sheet that names the refund and the site's cost
decisions.why: ways-out §6.9 and trust-returns-disputes §3: eBay marks the record, Mercari may charge up to 5%.
